text:
Priya: Urgent ask from Zephyr support  can we convert the 2pm onboarding office hour into a FedRAMP-focused drop-in today? They said security + deployment constraints only, 30m.
Liam: I can run the short demo if we trim slides. Which slot do they prefer?
Priya: They said earlier is better for their APAC/security folks. 10:30 PT was suggested by Zephyr.
Maya: I can take the compliance Q&A (10m). I have the FedRAMP checklist updated.
Nina: Sandbox needs a scrubbed dataset. I can scrub and snapshot a sandbox container, give me 20m.
Ravi: I can swap my 3pm customer check to free up team coverage. Priya, want me to own post-call notes?
Priya: Yes please own notes + health-cent update. I'll run the enablement pulse.
Liam: Can we switch demo to 10:40-10:55 and Q&A 10:55-11:05? keeps it tight.
Priya: Fine. @cs_scheduler_bot create new event at 10:40 PT titled "Zephyr - security drop-in (FedRAMP)" and add Zephyr_CISO, Noah from their infra team, and our SRE alias.
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event...  Done. Invite: https://cal.redwood.com/event/zephyr-security-1742113333 (10:40 PT / 17:40 UTC). Calendar updated.
Nina: Scrub runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub. I'll push snapshot -> event doc in 15m.
Maya: I'll prep a 1-pager checklist + 3 quick answers for on-prem vs hosted questions. Drop in chat during call.
Liam: Quick ask  which demo path: Dedicated cluster or hosted with KMS? I can show both but need to switch contexts.
Priya: Show hosted baseline, then one slide on Dedicated isolation. Keep actual demo on hosted.
Ravi: I'll take post-call actions: create ticket for any "renewal-risk" flags and tag AE.
Priya: Agenda (short):
```
10:40 Intro & goals (Priya)
10:42 Live demo (Liam)
10:55 Compliance Q&A (Maya)
11:05 Action items & next steps (Ravi)
```
Liam: Noted. I'll record and upload clip to event doc.
Nina: Sandbox snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/zephyr-snap-1742113333. PII stripped via scrub v2.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Nina. Email invites resent. Reminder set for 20m before.
Zephyr_CISO: (external) Confirmed the new time. Appreciate the checklist ahead of time.
Priya: Post-call: I'll send 2-question pulse: (1) Did this resolve your compliance blocker? (Y/N) (2) How confident are you to proceed on migration? (scale 1-5). Adding score to account health doc.
Ravi: If they ask about air-gapped deployments, mark as potential escalation and loop Solutions.
Maya: I'll be on standby 10:15-10:35 for pre-call sync.
Liam: Pre-call ack. See you at 10:15 in quick DM huddle.
Priya: Thanks team. Sharing pre-read now in the thread.
